subject: 2026-10-08-anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5-price-cut
text:
Brief says: "Banks running high-volume AI work such as customer service queries or compliance checks get a steep cost cut: Haiku 5.5 prices drop up to 90 percent against its predecessor" (note)
Source says: "Haiku 5.5 is designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summarization, database queries, classification, and live customer support, according to Anthropic." and "Real-world savings are likely smaller than the per-token prices suggest." (https://the-decoder.com/claude-haiku-5-5-arrives-with-massive-price-cuts-proving-the-ai-pricing-arms-race-is-far-from-over/)
Suggested fix: drop "compliance checks" (not in the source) and keep the caveat, e.g. "Banks running high-volume AI work such as customer support or database queries pay up to 90 percent less per token for most prompts, though The Decoder notes real-world savings are likely smaller because the new tokenizer uses slightly more tokens per task."
